name: Himenoki Azusa
source:
A student who takes the same bus route as Marika. While she is friendly and kind, she is also a bit strong-willed.

She has a boyfriend, but they have not had sex yet. He gets on the bus after Marika gets off, so they are never on the bus at the same time.

[From [url=http://studiocharen.r.ribbon.to/sessyoku/index.html]official site[/url]]
